name: Station Loom

potentialObjectiveMatches.name: Tandem Desk

potentialObjectiveMatches.name: Component Tide

potentialObjectiveMatches.name: Learning Loom

potentialObjectiveMatches.name: Queue Cushion

potentialObjectiveMatches.name: Flow Balance

potentialObjectiveMatches.name: Flow Caliper

closestPriorWorkflows: Flow Caliper estimates mean-load staffing bounds, not assignment of indivisible prerequisite tasks into paced stations.
Dependency Lens creates dependency-only timelines, not minimum station grouping under a cycle target.
Tandem Desk sequences multiple jobs across two existing machines, rather than assigning one cycle of work elements to the fewest stations.
